title: Keyboard-safe notification center focus and dismissal

behavior.dialogSemantics: The open notification popover has an explicit dialog relationship, visible heading label and modal semantics.
behavior.focusOnOpen: Opening the bell moves focus to the notification dialog close control so keyboard users have a deterministic starting point.
behavior.escapeDismissal: Escape closes the open notification view, discards an uncommitted preference view through the existing close path, and restores focus to the bell.
behavior.focusOnClose: The close control restores focus to the bell without changing read state or navigating outside the active workspace.
behavior.preserved: Tenant/role scope, filtering, pagination, unread summary, read/unread actions, preference saves, SSE reconnect and tenant-safe deep links remain unchanged.

localVerification.uiHarness: verify-local --ui-only --ui-spec=notifications.spec.ts remains to be run; it is expected to fail closed before fixture startup if 127.0.0.1:6379 is occupied.

limits: This increment changes only notification dialog accessibility and browser regression coverage.
CI verifies owned fixtures and does not deploy.
Production/live-provider, external delivery, remote durability/RPO-RTO, deployed and full-master acceptance remain open.
